statement: Implement Q11 under epic pilot-readiness-and-public-proof: public-path scale and failure certification across multi-node HTTP/Hono WASI components with typed selectors (Q2), multi-page accumulation (Q3), structured partials (Q4), multi-operation Service Cell v2 (Q5), learner progress proof (Q6), authenticated/encrypted node transport (Q7), RT2 host effect/buffer/cloning pressure accounting and bounded admission (src/runtime/wasi-component-cell-pressure-tracker.js, src/runtime/wasi-component-cell-runtime.js, src/runtime/wasi-component-cell-worker.js), and live fault-injection certification (src/service/public-path-scale-failure-certification.js, test/distributed/scenarios/public-path-scale-and-failure-certification.js).
